record.dic_text:
01082 balag {ba:-lag'}

字根型; TWOT - 245; 動詞

欽定本 - comfort 2, strength, strengthen 1; 4

1) 突現, 微笑
   1a) (Hiphil)
       1a1) 展現微笑, 看來愉快的 (#伯 9:27; 10:20; 詩 39:13|)
       1a2) 使之迸發, 或閃光 (#摩 5:9|)
record.edic_text:
01082 balag {baw-lag'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 245; v

AV - comfort 2, strength, strengthen 1; 4

1) to gleam, smile
   1a) (Hiphil) only
       1a1) to show a smile, look pleasant
       1a2) to cause to burst
